Security.title: Security
Security.description: How Suryca protects your data and your money — encryption, least-privilege access, and trading safeguards.
Security.heading: Security is a feature, not a footnote.
Security.intro: We build every Suryca product to protect your data and your money. Here’s how we think about it — and what we commit to.

practices.title: Encryption everywhere
practices.body: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Secrets are stored in a managed vault, never in code.

practices.title: Least-privilege access
practices.body: SSO and role-based access control on every system. Access is scoped, logged, and reviewed regularly.

practices.title: Hardened infrastructure
practices.body: Isolated environments, automated patching, and continuous monitoring on reputable cloud providers.

practices.title: Trading safeguards
practices.body: For Suryca Agents: hard risk limits, instant kill-switches, and a complete, replayable audit trail.

practices.title: Working toward formal compliance
practices.body: As we incorporate as Suryca Software Inc., we’re building toward SOC 2 Type II. Reach out for our current security overview.

Security.disclosureBody: Found a vulnerability? We want to hear from you. Email us with details and steps to reproduce, and we’ll acknowledge quickly and work with you on a fix. Please give us reasonable time before any public disclosure.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.description: How Suryca Software Inc. collects, uses and protects personal information.
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Suryca Software Inc. (“Suryca”, “we”) collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. It applies to our website and products.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Suryca Software Inc. is a company based in British Columbia, Canada. We are responsible for the personal information described in this policy, and we handle it in line with British Columbia’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and Canada’s Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). Our privacy officer can be reached at privacy@suryca.com.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
sections.body: Account details you provide, such as your name and email address; messages you send us, including through the contact form; basic usage and device data needed to run and secure the products; and the content you create or import while using Fizgot, ExportAIChat and Suryca Agents.

sections.heading: 3. How we use information & consent
sections.body: We use personal information to operate and improve the products, keep them secure, respond to you, and communicate with you about your account. We collect, use and disclose it only for purposes a reasonable person would consider appropriate, with your consent or as PIPA and PIPEDA otherwise allow. We do not sell personal information. We send marketing email only with your consent, as Canada’s anti-spam legislation (CASL) requires, and you can unsubscribe at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Your content
sections.body: Content you create or import is yours. We process it only to provide the service you’ve asked for, and you can export or delete it.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing
sections.body: We share personal information only with service providers that help us run Suryca — such as hosting, email delivery and analytics — and only as needed, under contracts that require them to protect it. We may also disclose information where the law requires it, for example in response to a lawful request from a Canadian authority.

sections.heading: 6. Where your information is stored
sections.body: Suryca is located in Canada, but some of our service providers store or process information outside Canada, including in the United States. While it’s there, it may be accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of that country. Contact our privacy officer for more about how we handle personal information outside Canada.

sections.heading: 7. Retention & security
sections.body: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as the law requires, then delete or de-identify it. We encrypt data in transit and at rest and limit access on a least-privilege basis. If a breach creates a real risk of significant harm, we’ll notify you and the relevant privacy commissioner as the law requires.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to access or correct the personal information we hold about you, ask how we’ve used or disclosed it, and withdraw your consent — subject to legal or contractual limits, and knowing that withdrawing consent may limit what we can provide. We’ll respond within the time PIPA and PIPEDA allow. If you’re not satisfied with our response, you can complain to the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia or the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies
sections.body: Our website sets no advertising or tracking cookies. Our products use cookies and similar storage only to keep you signed in and remember your preferences.

sections.heading: 10. Children
sections.body: Our website and products are not directed to children, and we don’t knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13.

sections.heading: 11. Changes & contact
sections.body: We’ll post material changes here and update the date above. Questions about privacy? Email privacy@suryca.com.

sections.heading: 1. Using our products
sections.body: You may use Suryca products in line with these terms and any product-specific rules. You must be old enough to form a binding contract where you live (19 in British Columbia), and you’re responsible for activity under your account.

sections.heading: 2. Your content & ownership
sections.body: You keep ownership of the content you create or import. You grant us the limited rights needed to host and process it so we can provide the service.

sections.heading: 3. Acceptable use
sections.body: Don’t use the products to break the law, infringe others’ rights, or disrupt the service. We may suspend or terminate accounts that do. You can stop using the products at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Trading & financial risk
sections.body: Suryca Agents can place trades within limits you configure. Trading carries risk of loss; past performance does not guarantee future results. Suryca is a software company, not a registered dealer, adviser or investment fund manager under the securities laws of British Columbia or anywhere else. Nothing in the products is investment advice, and you remain responsible for your mandate and for complying with the laws that apply to your trading.

sections.heading: 5. Availability & changes
sections.body: We work to keep the products available but can’t promise uninterrupted service. We may update features and these terms over time; if a change materially reduces your rights, we’ll give reasonable notice.

sections.heading: 6. Disclaimers & liability
sections.body: The products are provided “as is” and “as available.” To the extent permitted by law, we disclaim implied warranties and conditions, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim. Some laws, including British Columbia’s consumer protection laws, don’t allow certain exclusions or limits; where that’s the case, these apply only to the extent permitted.

sections.heading: 7. Governing law & disputes
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of British Columbia and the federal laws of Canada that apply there. Any dispute will be resolved in the courts of British Columbia, and you agree to their jurisdiction — unless the law where you live gives you the right to bring a claim in your local courts. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods does not apply.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.body: These terms are the entire agreement between you and Suryca Software Inc. about the products. Questions? Email hello@suryca.com.
